cve_summary: Integer overflow in download manager in Google Chrome prior to 75.0.3770.80 allowed a remote attacker to potentially perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page.
commit_message:
Early return if a download Id is already used when creating a download

This is protect against download Id overflow and use-after-free
issue.

BUG=958533

Change-Id: I2c183493cb09106686df9822b3987bfb95bcf720
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/1591485
Reviewed-by: Xing Liu <xingliu@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Min Qin <qinmin@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/master@{#656910}
docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * Creates an active download item in the DownloadManager.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * id (uint32_t): The unique identifier for the download item.  
 * info (const download::DownloadCreateInfo&): Information needed to create the download item.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * download::DownloadItemImpl*: A pointer to the newly created active download item, or nullptr if the item already exists.  
 *  
 * Logic:
 * The function creates a new download item using the provided information, stores it in the
 * downloads map, and attaches additional information to the download item before returning it.
 ******************************************************************************/
